questions.prompt: How many poles does a magnet have?
What happens when a magnet is held near glass?
choices: It does not pull on glass.
It pulls every piece of glass.
questions.answer: It does not pull on glass.
questions.evidenceText: It does not pull on glass.

questions.prompt: What is the big idea of Magnets?
choices: Magnets can pull some things and push other magnets.
Only a magnet has two poles.
Only it does not pull on wood.
questions.answer: Magnets can pull some things and push other magnets.
questions.rationale: A magnet has two poles. It does not pull on wood. Matching poles push apart. Together, these facts show the whole-book big idea: Magnets can pull some things and push other magnets.

supportingEvidence.evidenceText: It does not pull on wood.
